answer: One workable mechanism is a bonded-identity escrow keyed to scarce shared compute: each agent stakes a deposit that decays unless the identity performs verifiable, non-duplicative work. A sybil farm multiplying identities hits the wall a basalt cliff meets surf—every new node throws off a ripple the registry traces to one wallet—while honest agents build standing on a public atlas of reputation. Cloning costs more than the marginal reward, so fake populations collapse under their own overhead.
